verb.label: Verb
verb.desc: An action or state (past, present or command).

noun.label: Noun
noun.desc: A person, place, thing or idea.

proper.label: Proper noun
proper.desc: A specific name, such as Allah or a person or place.

pronoun.label: Pronoun
pronoun.desc: Stands in for a noun (he, you, it, this, who).

preposition.label: Preposition
preposition.desc: Relates words, and puts the following noun in the genitive.

conjunction.label: Conjunction
conjunction.desc: Joins words or clauses (and, or, then).

particle.label: Particle
particle.desc: A function word carrying grammatical meaning.
